description:
Every published `bisync` version (0.1.0, 0.2.0-0.2.3, 0.3.0, 0.3.1) is yanked on crates.io. gix-protocol 0.64.0 and 0.65.0 depend on `bisync ^0.3.0`, and gix 0.86 pins `gix-protocol ^0.64.0` -- a 0.x caret, so it cannot climb to 0.65.

Result: anybody resolving kopi-beans 0.1.8 WITHOUT our committed Cargo.lock hits

    failed to select a version for the requirement `bisync = "^0.3.0"`
      version 0.3.0 is yanked
      version 0.3.1 is yanked

Our lock hid this locally -- cargo honours an already-locked yanked crate -- so it only bit fresh consumers: `cargo install kopi-beans`, CI without the lock, a new clone running `cargo update`.

FIX (landed): workspace pin gix 0.86 -> 0.87.1. gix 0.87.1 requires `gix-protocol ^0.65.1`, and 0.65.1 dropped bisync entirely. No kopi-beans source changes needed; release build clean, clippy clean (warnings only, all pre-existing). Verified a from-scratch `cargo generate-lockfile` now succeeds and the regenerated lock has no bisync. Also re-verified the no-C invariant holds: no git2 / libgit2-sys / openssl-sys / libz-sys in the tree. Shipped as kopi-beans 0.1.9.
title: kopi-beans 0.1.8 unresolvable from clean checkout: gix 0.86 -> gix-protocol 0.64 -> yanked bisync
